lines.text: Nexalin announced a definitive 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement for Brazil and South America at 08:30 ET, with secondary coverage at 08:42 ET describing seven Latin American markets; no deal value, minimum purchase or revenue forecast was given. The desk reads it as a company-specific commercial development that lined up with the high-volume move, though the evidence does not show it caused the move.

The company announced at 08:18 ET that it completed the sale of Altruis Benefit Consulting for $8 million plus an earnout of up to $1 million, a deal already disclosed in a September 29 filing and September 30 coverage. The desk sees meaningful proceeds that advance its monetization strategy, though part of the payment is a secured promissory note rather than cash at closing, and the release adds uncertain new information.
